## [1.40.2](https://github.com/dawidd612/dudeks-morphe-patches/compare/v1.40.1...v1.40.2) (2026-11-06)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **hogwarts:** keep manual interaction taps with free energy ([6fd20b0](https://github.com/dawidd612/dudeks-morphe-patches/commit/6fd20b08eafe7ae551d40fdf41267024e6a2a82c))

patches.name: Google Calendar authentication via MicroG-RE
patches.description: Routes Calendar token requests and invalidation through MicroG-RE 7.1.1+. Requires Google Play services and the same account in Android and MicroG-RE.

patches.name: Stabilize schedule widget
patches.description: Rebuilds schedule widget row contents on Android 16+ to work around missing tiles, deformed tile backgrounds and recycled layout corruption. Intended for Realme UI 7. Does not reset the widget.

patches.name: Keep DM scroll position
patches.description: Prevents Instagram Direct from jumping to the newest message after replying to an older message. Requires Piko Add settings in the same patching run.

patches.name: Repair negative stars once
patches.description: Repairs a negative saved star balance to 2 when the garden reads it, once per installation, and skips the local unofficial-install dialog. No level completion needed. Gardenscapes 9.9.0 ARM64 only. Experimental.

patches.name: Coffee startup support
patches.description: Restores version-specific Unity startup after re-signing.

patches.name: Google Play Games via MicroG-RE
patches.description: Routes Google Play Games sign-in and player/server authorization through MicroG-RE 7.1.0+. Requires app.revanced.android.gms.

patches.name: Non-blocking update notice
patches.description: Replaces Coffee's blocking update/install notice with one short toast and continues loading the game.

patches.name: Skip rewarded ads
patches.description: Completes the requested rewarded-video flow locally using the game's callbacks.

patches.name: Google Play Games via MicroG-RE
patches.description: Routes Google Play Games sign-in and player/server authorization through MicroG-RE 7.1.0+ and suppresses obsolete stock Play services update prompts. Requires app.revanced.android.gms.

patches.name: Hide paid offers
patches.description: Hides real-money storefront sections and cancels Google Play checkout. Keeps in-game currency exchanges and existing purchase processing. Requires a supported ARM64 Pizza build.

patches.name: Non-blocking update notice
patches.description: Replaces Pizza's blocking game-update notice with one short toast and continues loading.

patches.name: Skip rewarded ads
patches.description: Completes the game's rewarded-video flow without playing an ad, keeping the requested placement and normal reward. Includes re-signed startup support.

patches.name: Faster action feedback
patches.description: Shortens the action button's local progress feedback from 0.3 to 0.125 seconds.

patches.name: Faster dialogue text
patches.description: Reveals dialogue text at 100 characters per second. Dialogue choices and manual advancement remain available.

patches.name: Faster interaction fades
patches.description: Speeds up the brief pause and fade in the action-button completion animation.

options.description: Each stage takes 0.5 seconds on Normal, 0.25 on Fast, or 0.125 on Very Fast.

patches.name: Faster lesson feedback
patches.description: Shortens the pauses after focus minigames and lesson banners while keeping earned grades and lesson progress.

patches.name: Hide automatic paid greeting
patches.description: Hides the paid greeting and two verified automatic starter offers. The shop and manually opened offers remain available.

patches.name: No energy consumption
patches.description: Keeps action costs without debiting energy. By default, each tap advances one point, even at an empty balance.

options.description: Advance one point per tap and show progress out of the original cost, or follow the game's tap setting.

patches.name: Quicker outfit previews
patches.description: Shortens avatar preview camera transitions when changing clothing categories or slots.

patches.name: Quicker reward reveals
patches.description: Shortens three pauses in the reward reveal screen while keeping the original reward and collection flow.

patches.name: Skip local quest waits
patches.description: Experimental. Finishes the local countdown for an already eligible quest through its normal expiry path. Objective cooldowns and event schedules still apply.

patches.name: Keep TikTok DM scroll position
patches.description: Keeps your position while reading older messages, including after sending messages and replies. Compatible with kveld9 patches.

patches.name: Hide Premium prompts
patches.description: Hides Premium offers and the menu entry. Removes the trial notification on launch.

patches.name: Local Premium
patches.description: Enables local Premium checks for navigation, offline map controls and ads. Does not activate a subscription on your account. Experimental; device testing needed.

patches.name: Play Store Fix
patches.description: Removes the Google Play installation check that blocks patched APKs at startup.

patches.name: Premium
patches.description: Enables Pro features, including after a purchase status refresh.
